source.nativeAnatomy: Headless closed shoulder cap, two chest eyes, navel mouth, two closed five-digit hands and two five-toe feet
source.preCompressionProtection: prepare appends normalization nodes and six local prop meshes; rig appends skin, clips and attachments. Native source BIN prefix and geometry/PBR records retained. Final compression is lossy.

localProps.method: Independent locally authored wooden shield, back handle and single-bladed axe fitted through unchanged native grips
localProps.inferred: Prop shape, size, material, hand choice and dance are artistic interpretations of 幹戚

runtime.compression: Meshopt medium, resample false, WebP2048; no simplify/flatten/join
runtime.worldTravel: Walk path baked into root; runtime does not add a second translation

parentRebuild.limitation: The post-build candidate-SHA assertion failed; the build itself succeeded. Intermediate GLB serialization ordering is plausible but not proven as the precise cause. No whole-file reproducibility claim.

parentStage.applicabilityToRebuild: Complete BIN byte identity preserves tested geometry, PBR, skin and animation data; rebuilt bytes also inspected with standard shot and closeups scripts

toolCollisions.method: Actual compressed triangles with BVH/bidirectional segment tests; exact coplanarity excluded

parentStage.strictMode: 23 snapshots through action switches/remounts, cached graph unchanged, no shared resource disposal

responsiveProjection.method: Actual projected triangle AABB to real DOM rectangles, 167 poses per viewport, required gap 8px
responsiveProjection.sourceAndDesign: Actual wheel scrolling reaches all four inference lines and classical text

parentVisual.observations: Closed headless cap, chest eyes and navel mouth legible; complete native grips hold independent axe/shield; soles and limbs remain coherent through movement.

limitations: Inherited wrist/lower-leg dark texture seams retained; no claim of seam-free native PBR.
Finite sampled poses and simulated viewport sizes are not an exhaustive continuous collision proof or physical-device performance certification.
Original quotation uses 形天; catalog display name 刑天 and all visual extrapolations remain separately documented.
